name: grid-browser-debug
description: Node deps for the WT credential-login driver: the official cloakbrowser npm package (stealth human layer — Bezier mouse curves, per-character typing, isTrusted CDP key events) riding on puppeteer-core, attached at runtime to the persistent CloakBrowser binary that launch.mjs owns. The login form's invisible Google reCAPTCHA scores the interaction; raw CDP evaluate fills fail it.
